Dear Hiring Committee,

I am writing to express my interest in the Research Assistant position for the PREDICT-ED project. I am a postdoctoral fellow at the Centre de recherche du CHUM, where I develop computational approaches for analyzing electronic health records.

My current work involves developing reproducible data pipelines to clean, integrate, and analyze complex healthcare datasets, applying machine-learning methods. I am also in charge of writing code to perform analyses in high-performance computing environments. These experiences align closely with PREDICT-ED’s goals of developing predictive models based on diverse data sources. I have ample experience working with longitudinal health data, which I have worked with during my doctoral and postdoctoral training. In the first case, I designed studies to collect and analyze optical and molecular longitudinal data, and wrote a manuscript on the use of generalized additive models to analyze biomedical data, which was published in _Statistics in Medicine_. In the second case, I have analyzed massive datasets (electronic health records) where multiple observations per individual are to be included.

My primary programming expertise is in R, which I have used extensively for data processing, modeling, visualization, and reproducible research. I am comfortable learning and translating workflows to Python, supported by a strong programming foundation and experience adapting computational approaches across research domains.

I have collaborated with clinicians, researchers, and multidisciplinary teams on biomedical and public health projects. My experience with health data science, version-controlled workflows, and computational research environments would allow me to contribute effectively to the development and evaluation of digital health solutions.

I am motivated by the opportunity to further develop my machine learning and artificial intelligence skills, while improving healthcare delivery and patient safety. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my skills to the PREDICT-ED team.

Thank you for your consideration. 

Sincerely,
